name: Coral Cave
description: Large open cavern at Dwejra, its walls and ceiling covered in colourful, very fragile corals. The opening, about 30 m wide, spans 17–18 m at the top to 28–30 m at the bottom, and the cave goes 50–60 m in, its sandy floor rising to about 21 m at the back. Well lit all the way.
conditions: Don't touch anything and keep your buoyancy and bubbles in check. Stay in the open part; the hole at the back is for trained cave divers only.
note: Researched October 2026; added because it was missing from OpenStreetMap's dive sites.
